data.long_meaning: English name derived from the Old English words 'wudu' (wood) and 'rā' (ruler). The name Woodrow was given to a person who lived or ruled in a wooded area. The name Woodrow carries the meaning “Ruler of the roe deer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Woodrow usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the roe deer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
